Darth Maul (Legends): Comic Vine respect thread, Erkan12 (Mar 4, 2019), read 2026-10-17
URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/profile/erkan12/blog/darth-maul-respect-thread-legends/136731/
Other Maul RTs found, not read yet: Erkan12 Canon RT (blog 129270, newer 154281), CV "Darth Maul Respect Thread - The Clone Wars" (forum 1553750), i_like_swords "Darth Maul's Power" and "Darth Maul - TPM" (listed in the CV Star Wars RT index, forum 2022954).
Rules: count only quoted source text. Many comic items in the RT are image-only (no text): listed as UNVERIFIED. No chapter numbers given (GAP).

== Statements (quoted) ==
- Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels (2005): "An incredible duelist second only, perhaps, to Darth Sidious."
- Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter (Michael Reaves, 2001): "His skills as a warrior were nonpareil." Raised as Sidious's "successor." Mastered the double-bladed lightsaber. "the Sith was far more powerful than she in the Force" (vs Darsha Assant).
- Darth Maul: Saboteur (James Luceno, 2001), Sidious: "Your skill as a sword master is peerless."
- Darth Plagueis (Luceno, 2012): Sidious calls him "the one-being army that is Darth Maul"; Plagueis: "his speed was astounding"; Plagueis won't "deny his mastery of the Jar'Kai technique"; after Maul beat Black Sun's Vigos: "Again, the Zabrak proves his value... You trained him well." Sidious on the Hypori test: "All things considered, he fought well, even after I deprived him of his lightsaber."
- The Dark Side Sourcebook (WotC RPG, 2001), final test: "he nearly bested his master with a flurry of deadly lightsaber blows. Sidious barely deflected them all." (Compare the Plagueis novel's version above, where Sidious disarms him. Newer and higher-authority prose is less flattering; weigh the novel more.)
- Wrath of Darth Maul (Ryder Windham, 2012): Sidious disarms him in the test; Maul bites his hand.
- Episode I Journal: Darth Maul (2000, Sidious's voice): Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan "went at him, two on one, and they could not defeat him."
- Insider #62 Fightsaber (2002): Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan's Form IV maneuvers "are little more than delaying tactics against the Form VII skills of Darth Maul."
- Jedi vs. Sith: Essential Guide to the Force (2007), Obi-Wan: "He used my anger against me, actually fed off my fury, gaining strength as I exhausted my own."
- Episode I Visual Dictionary (1999): "Maul is equal to two Jedi who are unprepared for his powers."
- Jedi Battles (2013): "it was clear that the Sith was more powerful" than Obi-Wan.
- Star Wars Tales 9 "Resurrection" (2001): a Maul clone fights Vader; the Prophets of the Dark Side: "They are more evenly matched than we suspected. But Maul will be victorious." RT says the clone beats Vader in the saber duel (image-only; outcome of the full story not checked; GAP).

== Feats (quoted) ==
- Shadow Hunter: beats Jedi Master Anoon Bondara ("within the first few moments... he himself was the superior fighter"); "moving easily five times faster than a human could travel at a dead run"; survives a 30 m fall; deflects Darsha's Force push.
- Maul: Lockdown (Joe Schreiber, 2013): beats Komari Vosa while wounded in the right arm ("His blade was moving almost too fast to see"; Vosa "no match for the erratic staccato blows"). Kills a wampa by reaching into its chest; kills a 4 m varactyl bare-handed; kills a Yuuzhan Vong warrior hand to hand. COMMON OPPONENT: Dooku also beat and killed Komari Vosa (his ex-Padawan; Clone Wars era).
- Darth Maul: Saboteur: moves so fast holo-recordings wouldn't show him unless slowed.
- Episode I Adventures 3 (1999): snaps durasteel binders; plucks four arrows from the air.
- Darth Maul (2000 comic) #1-4: kills Black Sun Vigos and their elite guards; resists Nightsister Mighella's lightning ("How can you... Resist..."). Image-only, UNVERIFIED panels.
- TPM novel (Terry Brooks): Force-throws "deadly missiles" at Obi-Wan.
- Post-bisection (The Clone Wars era, Legends tie-ins Death Sentence and Sith Hunters, 2012): with Savage, beats Obi-Wan + Ventress together ("not even their combined might was enough", Sith Hunters reference text); kills Jedi Masters Ko Solok and others; levitates 10+ men (image-only). These are TCW-continuity items that Legends shared until 2014; label as Clone Wars-era. [panel: panels/maul/maul-maul-savage-defeats-kenobi-ventress-clone-wars-1.jpg]
